description: Permanently delete a calendar share link so its public /calendar/share/<token> URL stops working. Irreversible; disabling the link in the Aidelly app is the reversible alternative. Returns 404 for unknown ids and for links in another workspace alike. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_delete_calendar_share_link
title: Delete Calendar Share Link
